headline: Bitcoin Trades Near $81,400 Amid Stock Market Volatility and ETF Inflows
summary: Bitcoin traded near $81,400, fluctuating between key technical levels, as institutional spot ETF inflows countered broader regional equity weakness and chip sector slides.
why: Cryptocurrencies increasingly trade in correlation with institutional liquidity flows, macroeconomic data releases, and broader equity market sentiment.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Strong spot ETF inflows provided support, while broader equity market pressures and resistance levels limited upward price momentum.

why_moved: Bitcoin prices drifted due to conflicting forces between robust daily spot ETF inflows and general risk-off sentiment spilling over from Asian equity markets.
